ex_01.m_zh: 讲故事的开头，慢一点，有点沉；“累得腰都直不起来”要说出重量
ex_01.d_zh: 画面：你翻开图画书，指着金字塔下面热烘烘的砖场。很多人弯着腰搬砖，汗一滴一滴往下掉，你替他们觉得累。
ex_01.m_en: storyteller opening, slow and a little heavy; real weight on 'their backs ached'
ex_01.d_en: Picture: you open the picture book and point at the hot brick yard under the pyramids. People bend low to carry bricks and sweat drips down. You feel tired for them.

ex_02.m_zh: 神气、爱指挥人，特别喜欢听自己的声音；最后一个“哼”鼻子朝天
ex_02.d_zh: 画面：你坐在高高的阴凉椅子上，旁边有人给你扇扇子。你用手杖指着下面搬砖的人，一边喊一边数砖。
ex_02.m_en: pompous and bossy, loving the sound of his own voice; a snooty 'Hmph' at the end
ex_02.d_en: Picture: you sit on a high chair in the shade while someone fans you. You point your stick at the workers below and count the bricks as you shout.

ex_03.m_zh: 很累、很轻，从心里说出来；“求你”前面吸一口气，不要演得太夸张
ex_03.d_zh: 画面：搬了一整天砖，你放下筐子，手都磨红了。你靠着土墙坐下，抬头看着傍晚的天，小声跟上帝说话。
ex_03.m_en: tired and quiet, from the heart; a breath before 'please'; not melodramatic
ex_03.d_en: Picture: you have carried bricks all day. You put down your basket and your hands are red and sore. You sit against the mud wall, look up at the evening sky, and talk quietly to God.

ex_04.m_zh: 温和，像换了一页；“胡子都白啦”带一点笑
ex_04.d_zh: 画面：你把图画书翻到新的一页：黄昏的旷野安安静静，一位白胡子老爷爷拄着手杖，身后跟着一群咩咩叫的羊。
ex_04.m_en: gentle, like turning a page; a small smile on 'his beard was white'
ex_04.d_en: Picture: you turn to a new page. It is evening in the quiet wilderness. An old man with a white beard walks with his staff, and his sheep follow him, going 'baa'.

ex_05.m_zh: 老爷爷的好奇；“咦”慢慢的、在想，“我过去看看”小声一点，像自言自语
ex_05.d_zh: 画面：你正赶着羊，忽然看见前面一丛矮矮的荆棘在冒金色的火，可叶子还是绿的。你停下来，揉揉眼睛。
ex_05.m_en: an old man's wonder; a slow, thinking 'hm' first; quieter on 'I'll go and have a look'
ex_05.d_en: Picture: you are walking with your sheep. A small thorn bush in front of you is full of golden fire, but the leaves are still green. You stop and rub your eyes.

ex_06.m_zh: 平静、低沉、慈爱，不要大声；像爸爸叫孩子的名字，两声中间留一点空
ex_06.d_zh: 画面：你早就认识这个老牧人，也一直看着他。现在他走近了，你轻轻叫他，像叫醒一个睡着的孩子。
ex_06.m_en: calm, deep and kind, not loud; like a father calling a child by name; a little space between the two
ex_06.d_en: Picture: you have known this old shepherd all his life and you have watched over him. Now he comes close. You call him gently, like waking a sleeping child.

ex_07.m_zh: 吓了一跳，然后变得谦卑、轻柔
ex_07.d_zh: 画面：空空的旷野里，火里竟然有声音叫你的名字。你倒退半步，四处看看没有别人，赶紧把鞋脱下来。
ex_07.d_en: Picture: the wilderness is empty, but a voice in the fire calls your name. You take half a step back, look around and see nobody, then quickly take off your sandals.

ex_08.m_zh: 稳稳的、温暖；“听见了他们的哭声”充满心疼，派他去的那句坚定又慈爱
ex_08.d_zh: 画面：你看得见远处埃及的砖场，听得见那里每一个人的叹气。你把这件最要紧的事，交给面前这个跪着的老人。
ex_08.m_en: steady and warm; full of care on 'heard them crying'; firm and kind on the sending
ex_08.d_en: Picture: you can see the brick yard far away in Egypt and hear every tired sigh there. You give this most important job to the old man kneeling in front of you.

ex_09.m_zh: 紧张、害羞，“就……就”真的结巴一下；最后像不好意思地笑着叹气
ex_09.d_zh: 画面：你用手指着自己的鼻子，直摇头。你只是个放羊的老头，一想到要站在法老面前说话，舌头就打结了。
ex_09.m_en: nervous and shy, a little stammer on 'I... I'; a self-conscious laugh-sigh
ex_09.d_en: Picture: you point at your own nose and shake your head. You are only an old shepherd. When you think of speaking to Pharaoh, your tongue gets stuck.

ex_10.m_zh: 温和，几乎有点想笑；很有耐心
ex_10.d_zh: 画面：摩西刚说了一大堆“我不行”。你没有生气，像爸爸要给孩子变个小魔术，看着他手里那根旧木杖。
ex_10.d_en: Picture: Moses has just said 'I can't' many times. You are not angry. Like a father about to show a child a little surprise, you look at the old wooden staff in his hand.

ex_11.m_zh: 好笑的害怕，又快又尖；第二个“蛇”更高
ex_11.d_zh: 画面：你刚把手杖丢到地上，它就扭来扭去变成了一条蛇！你吓得往后一蹦，两只手举得高高的。
ex_11.m_en: comic fright, quick and high with a squeak; the second 'snake' even higher
ex_11.d_en: Picture: you throw your staff on the ground and it wiggles and turns into a snake! You hop backward with both hands high in the air.

ex_12.m_zh: 慈爱、让人安心，声音里有微笑；“我会和你同在”放慢
ex_12.d_zh: 画面：摩西吓得躲得远远的。你等他喘口气，轻轻鼓励他伸手，就像教孩子第一次摸一只小狗。
ex_12.m_en: kind and reassuring, a smile in the voice; slower on 'I will be with you'
ex_12.d_en: Picture: Moses has jumped far away in fright. You wait for him to breathe, then gently tell him to reach out, like teaching a child to pat a puppy for the first time.

ex_13.m_zh: 先深深吸一口气，然后下定决心、勇敢起来；带一点微笑
ex_13.d_zh: 画面：蛇又变回了手杖，稳稳握在你手里。你看看它，再看看那团火，挺直了腰，转身朝埃及的方向。
ex_13.m_en: a deep breath, then decided and brave; a little smile
ex_13.d_en: Picture: the snake is a staff again, safe in your hand. You look at it, then at the fire. You stand up straight and turn toward Egypt.

ex_14.m_zh: 勇敢、清楚，声音有力（害羞的老爷爷不见了）；“让我的百姓走”前面停一拍
ex_14.d_zh: 画面：金光闪闪的王宫里，你一个人拄着手杖，走到高高的宝座前面。你抬起头，直直看着法老的眼睛。
ex_14.m_en: brave and clear, a strong voice now (the shy man is gone); a beat before 'Let my people go'
ex_14.d_en: Picture: in the shining gold palace you walk alone with your staff to the high throne. You lift your head and look straight into Pharaoh's eyes.

ex_15.m_zh: 先来一串假装的捧腹大笑；嘲笑人；到“就是不放”变成又犟又孩子气
ex_15.d_zh: 画面：你歪在宝座上，看着下面这个拿木棍的白胡子老头，觉得太好笑了。笑完你把两只胳膊一抱，下巴一抬。
ex_15.m_en: a big fake belly laugh first; mocking; then stubborn and childish on 'I won't'
ex_15.d_en: Picture: you lean back on your throne and look at the old man with a wooden stick. So funny! After you laugh, you fold your arms and lift your chin.

ex_16.m_zh: 轻快、有节奏，像一样一样数出来；说到“青蛙”忍不住笑一下
ex_16.d_zh: 画面：你一页一页快快地翻书：河水红了，青蛙一只接一只蹦进王宫，其中一只正好跳到法老的王冠上。
ex_16.m_en: brisk and lively, a list with rhythm; a little giggle on 'frogs'
ex_16.d_en: Picture: you turn the pages quickly. The river goes red. Frogs hop into the palace one after another, and one lands right on Pharaoh's crown.

ex_17.m_zh: 搞笑：先疑惑地学一声“呱？”，再尖叫；手忙脚乱，又快又尖，慌慌张张地投降
ex_17.d_zh: 画面：你觉得头顶上凉凉的、还会动。你往上一摸——是一只青蛙蹲在王冠上！你满屋子乱跳，想把它甩下来。
ex_17.m_en: comic: a puzzled 'ribbit?' then a squeal; flustered, fast and high; gives in in a panic
ex_17.d_en: Picture: something cold is moving on your head. You reach up... a frog is sitting on your crown! You jump all around the room and try to shake it off.

ex_18.m_zh: 心里有数、逗趣的口气，像在告一个淘气孩子的状
ex_18.d_zh: 画面：你凑到孩子耳边，挑挑眉毛：最后一只青蛙刚蹦出门，法老就把刚才说的话全忘啦。
ex_18.m_en: a knowing, teasing tone, like telling on a naughty child
ex_18.d_en: Picture: you lean close to the child's ear and lift your eyebrows. The last frog has just hopped out of the door, and Pharaoh forgets what he said.

ex_19.m_zh: 狡猾、得意，像唱歌；有点“略略略”的调皮劲儿
ex_19.d_zh: 画面：你从宝座后面探出头，左右看看，一只青蛙都没有了。你坐回去，翘起脚，朝摩西吐了吐舌头。
ex_19.m_en: sly and smug, sing-song; a cheeky nyah-nyah feel
ex_19.d_en: Picture: you peek out from behind your throne and look left and right. No more frogs! You sit back, put your feet up, and stick out your tongue at Moses.

ex_20.m_zh: 压低声音、认真，但是安稳、平静；“平平安安的”说得很暖
ex_20.d_zh: 画面：夜深了，一排小房子的门上都有红红的记号，发着柔和的光。屋里点着小灯，一家人靠在一起，很安全。
ex_20.m_en: hushed and serious, but safe and calm; warm on 'they would be safe'
ex_20.d_en: Picture: late at night. Every little house has a red mark on its door that glows softly. Inside, a small lamp is on and the family sits close together, safe.

ex_21.m_zh: 兴奋的小声，说得快，忙来忙去；“出发啦”带着激动
ex_21.d_zh: 画面：半夜的小屋里，你一边给弟弟妹妹系鞋带，一边往包袱里塞饼。你不敢大声，可是心怦怦跳。
ex_21.m_en: an excited whisper, quick and bustling; a thrill on 'leaving'
ex_21.d_en: Picture: in the little house at night you tie the children's sandals and push bread into a bag at the same time. You cannot speak loudly, but your heart is beating fast.

ex_22.m_zh: 这里不搞笑：疲惫、伤心、认输；先长长呼一口气，声音很轻
ex_22.d_zh: 画面：深夜的王宫空荡荡的，你一个人坐在宝座上，王冠歪了也不去扶。你没有力气再说“不”了，只是摆了摆手。
ex_22.m_en: no comedy here: tired, sorrowful, defeated; a long breath first; quiet
ex_22.d_en: Picture: the palace is empty late at night. You sit alone on your throne and your crown is crooked, but you do not fix it. You have no strength to say 'no' again. You just wave your hand.

ex_23.m_zh: 一大群人一起欢呼，高兴、不用整齐；有人在笑
ex_23.d_zh: 画面：天亮了，你和成千上万的人一起走出城门，再也不用搬砖了。你把手里的包袱高高举过头顶，跳了起来。
ex_23.m_en: a crowd cheering together, joyful and ragged; some laughing
ex_23.d_en: Picture: morning has come. You walk out of the city gate with thousands of people. No more bricks! You lift your bag high over your head and jump.

ex_24.d_zh: 画面：你指给孩子看：队伍最前面，有一根高高的、软软的白云柱子；到了晚上，它变成一根暖暖的火柱，像一盏大夜灯。
ex_24.d_en: Picture: you point for the child. At the front of the people stands a tall, soft pillar of white cloud. At night it becomes a warm pillar of fire, like a big night light.

ex_25.m_zh: 搞笑地发脾气：先反应过来，再气呼呼，最后大声下命令；说话像在跺脚
ex_25.d_zh: 画面：你走到阳台往下一看，砖场上空空的，一个人都没有。你愣了一下，然后跺着脚冲向你的金马车。
ex_25.m_en: comic tantrum: he realises, then outraged, then bossy shouting; a stamp in the rhythm
ex_25.d_en: Picture: you go to the balcony and look down. The brick yard is empty. Nobody! You stand still for a second, then stamp your foot and run to your golden chariot.

ex_26.m_zh: 害怕，说得快，喘着气；音调越来越高，一直到问句
ex_26.d_zh: 画面：你站在沙滩上，脚边就是海浪。你回头看见远处扬起一大片尘土，是兵车来了。你抓住摩西的袖子。
ex_26.m_en: frightened, fast and breathless; pitch rising to the question
ex_26.d_en: Picture: you stand on the beach with waves at your feet. You look back and see a big cloud of dust far away. The chariots are coming! You grab Moses' sleeve.

ex_27.m_zh: 平静、有力，是整个故事里最稳的声音；像把手放在她肩膀上
ex_27.d_zh: 画面：身边的人都慌了，米利暗拉着你的袖子。你把一只手稳稳地放在她肩上，另一只手握紧手杖，眼睛看着大海。
ex_27.m_en: calm and strong, the steadiest voice in the story; like a hand on her shoulder
ex_27.d_en: Picture: everyone around you is afraid and Miriam is pulling your sleeve. You put one hand on her shoulder, hold your staff tight in the other, and look at the sea.

ex_28.m_zh: 惊叹一层一层往上推；“哗”又快又大，“干干的路”充满敬畏
ex_28.d_zh: 画面：你站在人群里，大风吹得头发乱飞，吹了一整夜。天快亮的时候，眼前的海水像拉开的大门帘一样，朝两边退开。
ex_28.m_en: building wonder; quick and big on 'whoosh'; awe on 'dry path'
ex_28.d_en: Picture: you stand in the crowd. A strong wind blows your hair all night. Just before morning, the sea in front of you opens to both sides, like a big curtain.

ex_29.m_zh: 先是屏住呼吸的惊叹，然后高兴地招呼大家
ex_29.d_zh: 画面：你仰起头，左边右边都是高高的水墙，里面好像还有鱼游过。你看呆了一秒，回过神来，回头朝大家招手。
ex_29.m_en: breathless wonder first, then a happy call to the crowd
ex_29.d_en: Picture: you look up. On your left and right the water stands high like walls, and maybe a fish swims by inside. You stare for one second, then turn and wave to everyone.

ex_30.m_zh: 搞笑：先神气地喊冲锋，然后疑惑，接着摇摇晃晃地慌了，最后一声长长的哀叫
ex_30.d_zh: 画面：你站在金马车上冲进海底的路，威风极了。忽然“咯噔”一下，一个轮子自己滚走了，车歪了，两边的水墙也开始晃。
ex_30.m_en: comic: a proud battle-cry, then puzzled, then wobbling panic, then a long wail
ex_30.d_en: Picture: you ride your golden chariot onto the path in the sea and feel very grand. Then, bump! One wheel rolls away by itself. The chariot tips, and the walls of water start to shake.

ex_31.m_zh: 松了一口气，欢喜；“平平安安地”慢慢说、暖暖地说
ex_31.d_zh: 画面：哗啦一声，海又变回了平平的海。你数了数对岸的人：爷爷、妈妈、小宝宝、小羊，一个都没少。
ex_31.m_en: relief and joy; slow and warm on 'safe'
ex_31.d_en: Picture: with a big splash the sea is flat again. You count the people on the far shore: grandpa, mother, baby, little sheep. Everyone is there.

ex_32.m_zh: 湿淋淋、气鼓鼓的喷嚏，前面搞笑地憋着；小小的、傻傻的，不要大声
ex_32.d_zh: 画面：你浑身湿透坐在岸边，王冠里还有水，头上挂着一根海草。鼻子痒痒的，痒痒的，忍不住了。
ex_32.m_en: a soggy, sulky sneeze with a comic build-up; small and silly, not loud
ex_32.d_en: Picture: you sit on the shore, wet all over. There is water in your crown and seaweed on your head. Your nose tickles... tickles... and you cannot stop it.

ex_33.m_zh: 欢乐的、跟着铃鼓节拍的吟唱，半说半唱，带着笑；每一小句都要有弹跳感
ex_33.d_zh: 画面：你在对岸的沙滩上举起铃鼓，一边拍一边转圈跳舞，裙子都飞起来了。后面跟着一长串跳舞的人。
ex_33.m_en: a joyful chant in rhythm with the tambourine, half-sung, laughing; a bounce on every phrase
ex_33.d_en: Picture: on the far shore you lift your tambourine, shake it, and dance in circles so your skirt flies out. A long line of dancing people follows you.

ex_34.m_zh: 大家跟着她一起回应，开心、踩着节拍，不用太整齐
ex_34.d_zh: 画面：你在跳舞的队伍里，跟着前面的铃鼓拍手、跺脚。米利暗唱一句，你和大家就大声跟一句。
ex_34.m_en: the crowd echoing her chant, happy and in rhythm, a little ragged
ex_34.d_en: Picture: you are in the dancing line, clapping and stamping with the tambourine in front. Miriam sings a line, and you and everyone shout it back.

ex_35.m_zh: 温暖、感恩，老爷爷的微笑；慢慢说
ex_35.d_zh: 画面：歌声慢慢安静下来。你拄着手杖站在岸边，回头望望走过来的那片海，再低头看着面前的小朋友。
ex_35.m_en: warm and grateful, a grandfather's smile; slow
ex_35.d_en: Picture: the singing becomes quiet. You stand on the shore with your staff and look back at the sea you walked through. Then you look down at the child in front of you.

ex_36.m_zh: 温暖的结尾，直接对着小朋友说；最后一句带着笑
ex_36.d_zh: 画面：关灯以前，你帮孩子把被子拉好。孩子说有点怕黑，你握着那只小手，把这句话轻轻告诉他。
ex_36.m_en: a warm ending, speaking right to the child; a smile on the last sentence
ex_36.d_en: Picture: before the light goes off, you pull the blanket up for the child. The child says the dark is a bit scary. You hold the small hand and say this softly.
